items.question: What kinds of businesses do you work with?
items.answer: Mostly small and mid-sized teams who have outgrown manual processes but do not have an internal automation function. We work across e-commerce, SaaS, agencies, and professional services.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Most engagements run four to six weeks from first audit to a live system. Larger builds get split into phases so something useful ships early.

items.question: Which tools and platforms do you integrate with?
items.answer: Anything with an API, plus most of the usual stack: Shopify, Notion, Slack, HubSpot, Airtable, Google Workspace, and Stripe. n8n sits at the centre of most builds.

items.question: Can you work with our existing systems?
items.answer: Yes, and that is usually the point. We build around the tools your team already knows rather than asking you to migrate.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Book an assessment. We walk through your current workflow, identify what is worth automating, and give you a scoped plan before any commitment.
